title: Port desktop grid calculation to Android
changes: Replace the mobile grid approximation with the desktop band-limited aperture calculation for Android nearest scaling, including world and game UI layers.
validation: Mesa GLES shaders compiled and rendered both layers; nearest-mode output for three colors at twelve positions and scales matched an independent desktop-formula calculation within one channel value in android-grid-desktop-reference-wide-xe4le1ab.
ARM64 Docker build and Kotlin tests passed in android-grid-desktop-apk-ltq_cl99; installed with adb install -r on the connected Android phone.
limitations: Pixel-perfect GPU equivalence over all content and device performance remain unverified. Android lacks the other desktop scaling modes, temporal response and other menu features; on-device menu readability was not verified.
